Biomass (Part I) configuration

Source: R/config_biomass.R
om_biomass_config.Rd

Returns the full list of parameters that controls the spatio-temporal biomass operating truth. The "BET_ICCAT" preset is the configuration used in Experimento 02 (bigeye tuna, ICCAT BET-A stock area, 1950-2025, seed 20261005) and reproduces its results exactly.

Usage

om_biomass_config(preset = "BET_ICCAT", ...)

validate_biomass_config(cfg)

Arguments

preset

Name of a preset (see om_presets()).

...

Optional named sections that override the preset, passed to om_config_update() (e.g. population = list(r = 0.4)).

cfg

A biomass configuration.

Value

A list of class om_biomass_config.

Details

The list has the sections

general

label, seed.

temporal

year_start, year_end.

spatial

source of the spatial domain (source = "iccat" for the 1x1 ICCAT grid bundled with the package, "gpkg" to read a GeoPackage, read by om_domain_from_gpkg() with geodesic areas from lwgeom), the stock area (stock_code, selection), and the latitudinal regions (region_breaks, ascending; region_labels, ordered from north to south, one more than the breaks).

population

Pella-Tomlinson surplus production with an exogenous removal rate u(y) drawn by phases (u_base, decline, recovery), AR(1) process error, optional shocks (events) and a trend in carrying capacity (K_trend). model may also be a function f(B, K, r, shape) returning the surplus production.

habitat

static log-density: latitudinal envelope (envelope_type = "latitude": Gaussian on signed latitude, the tropical core of Experimento 02; "abs_latitude": Gaussian on absolute latitude, i.e. one band per hemisphere, for temperate species), Gaussian hotspots, longitudinal gradient, persistent random field (field_sd, field_range) and an optional custom_effect = function(cells) returning a log-scale vector.

shift

poleward redistribution: expansion of the envelope standard deviations, drift of its centre and equatorial contraction along a ramp between start and end.

stochastic

spatio-temporal AR(1) noise on Gaussian fields.

output

what om_write_biomass() saves and figure settings.

Functions

  • validate_biomass_config(): Checks the internal coherence of a biomass configuration (stops with an explicit message).

See also

om_fishery_config(), om_config_update(), simulate_biomass().

Examples

cfg <- om_biomass_config("BET_ICCAT")
cfg$population$r
#> [1] 0.3
cfg2 <- om_biomass_config("BET_ICCAT", population = list(r = 0.45),
                          shift = list(enabled = FALSE))
cfg2$population$r
#> [1] 0.45
